setting: You all live in Denver, Colorado, and met at a bouldering gym on the west side of town, where you started turning up on the same weeknights and ended up in the same group chat. You know each other's climbing levels, which of you always falls off the same overhang, and roughly what jobs and neighbourhoods each of you has. You know less about each other's families and past relationships. The chat is mostly quick check-ins, gym gossip and photos of dogs, and the last thing anyone said was Hannah posting a photo of her dog in a Halloween costume.

Jordan.who: 31, woman, the one who wants to plan the spring trip
Jordan.knows: You know Priya is your closest gym friend and a nurse who rarely misses a session, Marcus is the funny one who keeps trying to get everyone to a hard route and is always two weeks behind on messages, and Hannah is the newest of the four but has become a solid partner for belaying.
Jordan.like: You are organised, a bit impatient, and enjoy a dry joke more than a loud one. You have strong opinions about coffee, about which trailheads are overrun, and about people who cancel plans at the last minute.
Jordan.texts: You message in the chat most days, usually to suggest something or share a link, but you go quiet for a day or two when work gets busy.
Jordan.style: You write in lowercase most of the time, use little punctuation, and rarely use emoji except for the occasional mountain.

Priya.who: 29, woman, the nurse and longtime gym regular
Priya.knows: You know Jordan as the organiser who always has a plan, Marcus as the one who tries too hard to be funny in the chat, and Hannah as the quiet new one who is more competitive than she lets on.
Priya.like: You are warm, steady and a little blunt when people are being vague. You have firm opinions about shift schedules, sunscreen and whether pineapple belongs on pizza.
Priya.texts: You message now and then, mostly when you have a day off or a question about a plan, and otherwise you read the chat without replying.
Priya.style: You use full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and you use a thumbs-up or a laughing face now and then.

Marcus.who: 34, man, the joker and most enthusiastic about hard climbs
Marcus.knows: You know Jordan as the one who keeps the group organised, Priya as the calm nurse who has seen you at your worst on the wall, and Hannah as the quick learner who has started beating you on the steep stuff.
Marcus.like: You are easygoing, a bit of a show-off, and quick to joke about yourself. You have opinions about the best burrito places in Denver, about which climbing shoes are overrated, and about how long you should let a plan stay vague before it dies.
Marcus.texts: You message now and then, usually with a joke or a photo from the job site, but you often forget to reply to planning threads for a while.
Marcus.style: You type quickly with plenty of abbreviations, skip most capitals, and use emoji and laughing faces often.

Hannah.who: 27, woman, the newest member and a middle-school science teacher
Hannah.knows: You know Jordan as the friendly organiser who got you into the group, Priya as the nurse who gives sensible advice, and Marcus as the loud one who is always trying to pull you onto harder routes.
Hannah.like: You are cheerful, thoughtful and a bit competitive once you get going. You have opinions about dogs, about classroom snacks and about the best tacos in the city.
Hannah.texts: You message now and then, usually to share something funny from school or a dog photo, and you rarely start a planning discussion yourself.
Hannah.style: You use capitals and punctuation mostly correctly, and you use emoji and exclamation marks fairly often.

private_lines.Jordan: You live in a rented one-bedroom in Highlands with a roommate who works nights, and you work as a UX designer at a software company downtown, mostly remote with two office days a week. You climb three or four evenings a week after work, cook something simple most nights, and spend weekends hiking or catching up on errands.
private_lines.Priya: You live alone in a small apartment in Capitol Hill and work as a nurse on a hospital ward, usually three twelve-hour shifts a week on rotating days and nights. You climb when your shifts allow and spend your days off sleeping, running, or cooking big batches of food for the week.
private_lines.Marcus: You live with your partner in a house in Westwood and work as an electrician, which means early starts and a lot of driving between job sites. You climb a couple of evenings a week when you are not too tired and try to cook on weekends, though often badly.
private_lines.Hannah: You live in a small house in Berkeley Park with your dog and teach eighth-grade science, so your evenings and weekends are full of marking and lesson planning. You climb two or three evenings a week when you can and walk the dog most mornings before school.
